Chapter 7179: Can’T Hold On

Chapter 7179: Can’t Hold On

As bolts drilled into the true primordial tree, other manifestations in various worlds ignited in harmonization. The bolts became weaker and weaker before being led to the roots, turning into safe worldly energies.

Nonetheless, the main currents continued to assault the wall. The invigorated immortals suffered terrible injuries again but there was no way out.

“Keep it up!” Purewood Divine Emperor and Immortal Emperor Hao Hai shouted, relying on sheer willpower alone as the flesh no longer cooperated.

“Creak!” The wall was on the verge of crumbling.

“Duck egg, are you doing your best?!” Duality shouted.

“Shit yes I am! The primordial trees are filled with tribulations now, if I relax, the whole world is finished!” The duck egg buyer, Li Baye, shouted back.

The trees had plenty of tribulations but the refining process was slow. They couldn’t just release bolts to the wild before refinement.

Since the trees couldn’t take any more in, Duality Master and the source bolt couldn’t handle the flow any longer. If this continued, the bolts would overflow into Desolate Frontier.

“Bam!” Immortal screamed in agony as another corner shattered.

“Take this!” Empress Hong Tian used her dao to divert the bolts into Duality Master’s border.

“I can’t!” Duality shouted.

“Don’t hold back, show us what you can do!” Li Baye shouted.

“Hold back what?! I was lazy and never cultivated before! You’re going to kill me!” Duality bellowed in pain. The border in the form of a river holding back the bolts bled profusely.

“I’m coming.” Immortal Assailant Emperor broke rank and turned into a primal dao rune.

This dao rune floated over Duality’s river and began absorbing tribulations. She had researched this for a long time but couldn’t handle the sheer volume.

“We can’t hold on any longer!” Duality shouted at Li Baye: “Hey, go find the old man!”

“You find him, you’re his son!” Li Baye barked back.

“Who knows where he is!” Duality responded as his body was pushed to the limit: “Old man, are you alive?! We’re going to die!”

Alas, no one answered him.

“Fuck, this is the end.” The river cracked and lightning bolts roamed free.

“High Heaven Suppression!” Empress Hong Tian burned her true blood and turned into a supreme fiery being.

Her flames illuminated Heavenrealm as she performed her signature technique. The lightning bolts assaulted her but she sealed them within her body.

“Buzz.” Suddenly, everything came to a halt, the tribulations included.

A figure appeared before the Bulwark of Apocalypse, meeting the tribulations directly. He wore a white robe, looking ordinary yet profound.

Heaven and earth fell silent. Even the raging tribulations lost their powers and became soundless.
